title: Working in the NHS pre, during & post training

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚取超越“以时间换金钱”的收益，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士（Dr. Marianne Trent），自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特（Sophie Foote）的“一对多”项目现在正式开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将自己的专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在2022年完成过这个项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属推广链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括为期六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组智囊团（masterminds）、大师班、个性化指导、一份来自福通与梅森（Fortnom and Mason）的精美礼品，以及一个限时的一对一教练福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 欢迎通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有志心理学家播客》（Aspiring Psychologist Podcast）。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening and thank you if you have previously listened to other episodes as well.
sentences.zh: 感谢你的收听，也感谢之前收听过其他节目的听众。

sentences.en: We are nearing our 8,000th download in a little under six months and it's all thanks to you,
sentences.zh: 在短短不到六个月的时间里，我们的下载量即将突破8,000次，这全都要归功于你们，

sentences.en: my very loyal listeners or maybe even my brand new listeners who are finding this content really useful.
sentences.zh: 我那些非常忠实的听众，或者可能还有觉得这些内容非常实用的新听众。

sentences.en: I would love to know what your favourite episode is and I would love for you to share it on socials and tag me in.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你最喜欢哪一期节目，也非常希望你能将其分享到社交媒体并@我。

sentences.en: You can do that on your stories in Instagram by tagging in Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Instagram的快拍中@玛丽安·特伦特博士（Dr. Marianne Trent）。

sentences.en: You can do that on LinkedIn as well.
sentences.zh: 你也可以在领英（LinkedIn）上这样做。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: You can do it on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你还可以在脸书（Facebook）上这样做。

sentences.en: Tag me in there as Good Thinking Psychological Services.
sentences.zh: 在那里@我：美好的思维心理服务（Good Thinking Psychological Services）。

sentences.en: Or if we're connected on Facebook, you can tag me as Marianne Trent as well.
sentences.zh: 或者如果我们加了脸书好友，你也可以@玛丽安·特伦特（Marianne Trent）。

sentences.en: Tag me in all those places.
sentences.zh: 在所有这些地方都可以@我。

sentences.en: That would also be wonderful.
sentences.zh: 那也会非常棒。

sentences.en: But tell people why you like the episode and why it resonates with you.
sentences.zh: 但请告诉大家你为什么喜欢这期节目，以及它为什么能引起你的共鸣。

sentences.en: Encourage others to listen to as it really helps me know that this content is useful and beneficial for you.
sentences.zh: 鼓励其他人来收听，因为这真的能让我知道这些内容对你们是有用和有益的，

sentences.en: And that you are pleased to be in my world.
sentences.zh: 并且让知道你们很高兴能来到我的世界。

sentences.en: What am I going to talk to you about today?
sentences.zh: 今天我要和大家聊些什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, today I'm going to talk to you about my experiences of working in the National Health Service,
sentences.zh: 好吧，今天我要和大家聊聊我在国家医疗服务体系（NHS）工作的经历，

sentences.en: both as an assistant psychologist, as a trainee psychologist and then as a qualified psychologist too.
sentences.zh: 既当过助理心理学家，当过见习心理学家，后来也当过正式注册的心理学家。

sentences.en: There is no real plan to this episode.
sentences.zh: 这期节目并没有什么真正的计划。

sentences.en: It is going to be a case of, you know, winding her up and watching her go, see where I go.
sentences.zh: 这就好比是，你知道的，上紧发条看着它运转，看看我会聊到哪里。

sentences.en: But I hope you'll find it useful because I know for many people who are striving to progress their career in psychology,
sentences.zh: 但我希望你会觉得它很有用，因为我知道对于许多渴望在心理学领域进阶职业生涯的人来说，

sentences.en: it feels like, you know, working for the NHS, certainly if you want to get onto clinical training
sentences.zh: 感觉就像是——在NHS工作，当然如果你想进入临床培训

sentences.en: and be funded by the NHS to train, it feels like acquiring some NHS experience prior to commencing your training is going to be beneficial for you.
sentences.zh: 并由NHS资助进行培训的话——在开始培训之前积累一些NHS的工作经验会对你大有裨益。

sentences.en: With that, I would say it's not always necessary.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我认为这并不总是必需的。

sentences.en: So you know that I, if you've been in my world a while, you'll know anyway that I previously worked at St Andrew's Healthcare.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在我的世界里待了一段时间，你就会知道我以前曾在圣安德鲁医疗保健机构（St Andrew's Healthcare）工作过。

sentences.en: And actually there are people I worked with there who got onto professional doctorate courses
sentences.zh: 事实上，我在那里共事过的一些人，他们只在圣安德鲁工作过，

sentences.en: having only ever worked in St Andrew's, but usually under the supervision of a qualified psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 但通常是在合格心理学家的监督下，就成功考入了专业博士课程。

sentences.en: So for me, I think it is more about the quality of your supervision and the type of work that you're being asked to do that is psychologically informed
sentences.zh: 所以对我而言，我认为这更多取决于你所接受的监督质量，以及你被要求去做的工作类型是否具有心理学依据，

sentences.en: and, you know, just absolutely on model for what you'd be doing really in your realm of professional psychology.
sentences.zh: 并且，你知道的，这完全符合你在专业心理学领域中实际要做的事情的模式。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I don't think it's so much the organisation, although of course the ability to work with MDTs and large teams and, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为这不完全取决于机构，尽管能够与多学科团队（MDTs）及大型团队合作，并且，你知道的，

sentences.en: to hold caseloads and work with a variety of clients and professionals too is advantageous and that is something that the NHS does afford you.
sentences.zh: 能够承办案例并在各种客户和专业人员中工作是有优势的，而这正是NHS能够为你提供的。

sentences.en: So I did work for local government before I started working for St Andrew's
sentences.zh: 所以在开始在圣安德鲁工作之前，我确实为地方政府工作过，

sentences.en: and, you know, I think working for any large organisation that's well established and has lots of policies and procedures and, you know, where things don't happen overnight
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我认为为任何大型、成熟、拥有大量政策和程序、且事情不会一夜之间发生变化的组织工作，

sentences.en: can be really good experience for boosting your own CV and your skills and your talents, but also for knowing how large organisations work.
sentences.zh: 对于提升你自己的简历、技能和才华，以及了解大型机构的运作方式，真的能带来很好的经验。

sentences.en: So, similarly, St Andrew's was a large hospital and it's since expanded to have other locations as well and so, you know, that is, yeah, it is a large organisation
sentences.zh: 所以同样的，圣安德鲁是一家大型医院，后来它又扩展到了其他地点，所以，你知道的，是的，它是一个大型组织，

sentences.en: and they do work differently than smaller ones.
sentences.zh: 它们的运作方式与较小的机构确实不同。

sentences.en: So my own organisation, Good Thinking Psychological Services, is very small comparatively and so I can do things in a really adaptive and, if needs to be, reactive way
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我自己的组织——美好的思维心理服务（Good Thinking Psychological Services）要小得多，所以我可以用非常灵活的方式做事，如果有必要的话，还可以采取反应迅速的方式，

sentences.en: in the way that I found to be quite frustrating that you couldn't do in the NHS towards the end of my time there.
sentences.zh: 而在我NHS生涯的尾声，我发现很多事情在那里是无法做到的，这曾让我感到相当沮丧。

sentences.en: You know, I can come up with different techniques and approaches and roll with them the same day if I want to and you just can't do that in the NHS
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我可以提出不同的技术和方法，如果我想的话，当天就能推行，但在NHS里你是做不到这一点的，

sentences.en: and that is frustrating to someone who wants to innovate and can see ways for changing and, you know, for clients to have better experiences.
sentences.zh: 对于一个想要创新、能看到改变途径、并希望客户获得更好体验的人来说，这确实令人沮丧。

sentences.en: But this is a whole separate debate.
sentences.zh: 但这完全是另一个话题了。

sentences.en: So my first experience of working for the NHS was when I was an assistant psychologist and the way that the funding pots work
sentences.zh: 所以，我第一次在NHS工作的经历是在我担任助理心理学家的时候，资金池的运作方式

sentences.en: means that it was a slightly different employing sort of base than where I was actually working because it's kind of divvied up.
sentences.zh: 意味着它与我实际工作的雇主基础略有不同，因为它是被划分开来的。

sentences.en: So I was working for what was Milton Keynes Hospital but I actually wasn't working on the Milton Keynes Hospital site.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时为米尔顿凯恩斯医院（Milton Keynes Hospital）效力，但我实际上并没有在米尔顿凯恩斯医院的院区工作。

sentences.en: I was working nearby at a youth prison.
sentences.zh: 我是在附近的一所少管所工作。

sentences.en: So at that point it was quite novel for the healthcare systems to be operated by the NHS but certainly that one was
sentences.zh: 所以在那个时候，由NHS来运营医疗保健系统还是相当新颖的，但那一个确实是，

sentences.en: and so it was a really nice opportunity to get an NHS funded assistant post but I was working under the qualified direction of a qualified forensic psychologist
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个获得NHS资助的助理职位的绝佳机会，我在一位合格的法医心理学家的专业指导下工作，

sentences.en: but I was very clear that my job title was assistant clinical psychologist so I was doing clinical work and not stuff necessarily indicated with the young person's index offence
sentences.zh: 但我非常清楚我的职位头衔是临床助理心理学家，所以我做的是临床工作，做的事情不一定与年轻人的主罪（index offence）直接相关，

sentences.en: more about their wellbeing and their, you know, I guess their relationship to trauma as well which of course is indicated often with the index offence
sentences.zh: 更多的是关于他们的福祉，以及，你知道的，我猜还有他们与创伤的关系——当然，这通常也与主罪有关，

sentences.en: but similarly to a previous episode where I mentioned the wonderful QC Chris Dawes book Justice on Trial you know, there's a lot of trauma within justice systems
sentences.zh: 但就像我之前在一期节目中提到杰出的QC克里斯·道斯（Chris Dawes）的书《审判正义》（Justice on Trial）时所说的那样，司法系统中存在着大量的创伤，

sentences.en: both adult and young people.
sentences.zh: 无论是成年人还是年轻人都是如此。

sentences.en: So I actually only worked for the NHS for six months so I started in February and I left in August to go off travelling because I'd got a place on the doctorate scheme
sentences.zh: 所以实际上我在NHS只工作了六个月，我从2月开始工作，然后在8月辞职去旅游，因为我拿到了博士项目的名额，

sentences.en: and I just, you know, got all footloose and fancy free and went off and had a really lovely time
sentences.zh: 我当时就，你知道的，无拘无束、随心所欲地出发了，度过了一段非常美好的时光，

sentences.en: with another friend who was actually going to be starting her own clinical doctorate course as well so yeah, if you are listening to this
sentences.zh: 和另一位朋友一起——她其实也将要开始她自己的临床博士课程，所以，是的，如果你正在收听这个节目，

sentences.en: because you are going to shortly be starting as a trainee psychologist then is there any possibility that you could have a bit of time off
sentences.zh: 是因为你即将开始作为一名见习心理学家，那么你有没有可能在人生的这些重要篇章之间腾出一点时间，

sentences.en: between these important chapters of your life where you don't necessarily need to be thinking about what this gap looks like on your CV and what you might be missing out on
sentences.zh: 你不必去想这段空白在你的简历上看起来是什么样，也不必去想你可能会错过什么，

sentences.en: it's more of a chance of how can you replenish yourself how can you reward yourself for this time that you've really spent
sentences.zh: 这更多是一个机会，去思考如何补充自己，如何为自己这段真正花时间

sentences.en: focusing on a really, you know, really important destination so yeah, again, it's a bit of another aside isn't it you never know where I might end up
sentences.zh: 专注于一个非常、你知道的，非常重要的目标的时光进行奖励——所以，是的，这又是一个题外话了，对吧？你永远不知道我最后会聊到哪里去，

sentences.en: but, you know, if you are going to be applying for clinical training next year or any type of professional psychology training
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，如果你打算在明年申请临床培训或任何类型的专业心理学培训，

sentences.en: if you do learn in spring or summer that you have been successful then how could you free yourself up to imagine that you might spend some of that time
sentences.zh: 如果你在春季或夏季得知自己成功入选，那么你该如何解放自己，去想象你可以利用其中一部分时间——

sentences.en: you know, you could dream big you know, you could dream a little round the world trip obviously this is finances depending but also dependents depending as well
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你可以放飞梦想，你可以梦想来一次环球旅行（当然这取决于你的财务状况，也取决于是否有家属需要照顾），

sentences.en: so if you are a parent or you've got people that you care for that might be, that might feel slightly more aspirational but, you know, are the things that you would like to do
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是一位父母，或者你需要照顾其他人，那可能会感觉稍微更有抱负一些，但是，你知道的，有哪些事情是你想要做的，

sentences.en: to help you celebrate that phase in your life could you, I don't know, book yourself a few spa treatments or beauty treatments
sentences.zh: 来帮助你庆祝你人生中的那个阶段？你可不可以，不知道，为自己预订几个水疗或美容护理项目，

sentences.en: or go and stay with friends in a different part of the country or go and, you know, have a couple of days in an Airbnb somewhere nice and by the sea
sentences.zh: 或者去国内不同地方的朋友家小住，或者去，你知道的，在某个风景优美、面朝大海的Airbnb度过两三天，

sentences.en: to really just recharge yourself and to celebrate you and your well-done-ness but I feel like this is a whole separate episode that probably needs to be recorded, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 真正地让自己充电，庆祝你自己以及你所取得的卓越成就？我觉得这完全可以单做一期节目来录制，对吧？

sentences.en: So, NHS so I worked there for six months and then I went off travelling yeah, that's why I got distracted because that sounded more exciting than working for the NHS
sentences.zh: 所以，关于NHS，我在那里工作了六个月，然后就去旅游了——是的，这就是为什么我分心了，因为听起来比在NHS工作要刺激得多，

sentences.en: and it was but yeah, I did take a lot of value from my fellow nursing colleagues and my forensic psychology supervisor it was quite a small organisation to work for
sentences.zh: 确实如此——但是，是的，我从我的护理同事和法医心理学主管那里获益匪浅，我工作的机构其实很小，

sentences.en: quite a small base, I should say that I was working for and that was very different than having worked for a large hospital with many different divisions
sentences.zh: 可以说是一个相当小的基地，这与在拥有许多不同部门的大型医院工作有很大不同，

sentences.en: so, you know, just having to get used to
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，只需要习惯

sentences.en: a little bit more of yeah, just a smaller way of yeah, just thinking and operating you might just have heard that little ping from my emails that meant that I forgot to
sentences.zh: 更多一点，是的，一种更小规模的，是的，思考和运作的方式——你可能刚刚听到了我的电子邮件发出的那个小小的“叮咚”声，这意味着我忘记了

sentences.en: I forgot to shut my emails down before I filmed so, yeah, I'm sorry about that I will try and edit it out if I can but it might well just stick around so,
sentences.zh: 我拍摄前忘记关闭电子邮件了，所以，是的，对此我很抱歉，如果可以的话我会尽量把它剪掉，但它很可能会一直留在里面，所以，

sentences.en: training for me
sentences.zh: 对我的培训而言，

sentences.en: because I was a trainee clinical psychologist was three years of being employed by the NHS at band 6 and for me, going from band 4 to band 6
sentences.zh: 因为我是一名见习临床心理学家，那是在NHS以薪级6（band 6）受雇的三年生涯，对我来说，从薪级4升到薪级6，

sentences.en: that was quite a nice pay rise at the time
sentences.zh: 在当时算是一次相当不错的加薪，

sentences.en: so, working for the NHS meant that you obviously have to be an employee for them and adhere to their trust values and, you know, their principles and their protocols
sentences.zh: 所以，在NHS工作意味着你显然必须成为他们的员工，遵守他们的信托价值观，并且，你知道的，遵守他们的原则、协议

sentences.en: and their procedures and you need to be, you know, a good employee you need to be thinking about you know, where possible trying to keep your sick leave absence
sentences.zh: 和程序，你需要成为一个，你知道的，好员工，你需要考虑，你知道的，在可能的情况下尽量把病假缺勤

sentences.en: as little as possible because they're going to be looking at your attendance and, you know, the same is true even with when you are a trainee psychologist if you are being employed
sentences.zh: 控制得越少越好，因为他们会考察你的出勤率，并且，你知道的，即使当你是一名见习心理学家时也是如此，如果你被雇用的话，

sentences.en: that they have to make sure that you are well enough to be in your role and that you are, you know
sentences.zh: 他们必须确保你的健康状况足以胜任你的角色，并且你，你知道的，

sentences.en: creating good value for the NHS because there's work that you need to be doing
sentences.zh: 正在为NHS创造良好的价值，因为有你需要去做的工作，

sentences.en: you know, the core work so they want you to be seeing clients on placement and, ideally, helping those clients to move towards their goals but also helping the service
sentences.zh: 你知道的，核心工作，所以他们希望你在实习期间接待客户，理想情况下，帮助这些客户朝着他们的目标前进，同时也帮助服务机构

sentences.en: move towards its goals as well there's, you know, there's a lot of a lot of balls to juggle when you are a trainee psychologist
sentences.zh: 朝着它的目标前进，你知道的，当你是一名见习心理学家时，有许多、许多事情需要兼顾，

sentences.en: you know, you've got to juggle the responsibilities for your own line management so when I was training my line manager was based in a different hospital
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你必须兼顾你对自己直线管理的责任——所以自我培训时，我的直接主管在另一家医院，

sentences.en: and we never really crossed paths other than him signing off on my expenses every month for driving about here, there and everywhere and parking costs and things
sentences.zh: 我们实际上从没有真正碰过面，除了他每个月在我的报销单上签字，以报销我开车到处跑以及停车费等开销，

sentences.en: but, yeah, I don't think I ever had to see him for anything else at all during my three years and I think even during those three years
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我想在我三年的时间里我大概再也没有因为任何其他事情见过他，而且我想甚至在那三年里，

sentences.en: I think the original chap retired and then someone else came along and I don't think I met him in a managerial capacity as well but during training you will usually have placements
sentences.zh: 最初的那位老兄退休了，然后换了别人，我想我也没在管理层面上见过他——但在培训期间你通常会有实习期，
